This script prepares ETN data for upload to a [GBIF IPT](https://gbif.org/ipt). 

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

Load libraries:

```{r}
library(etn)
library(yaml)
```

## Set animal_project_code

```{r}
animal_project_code <- "2014_DEMER"
```

## Read yaml with user-defined values

```{r}
datasets <- yaml::read_yaml(here::here("src", "datasets.yml"))
dataset <- purrr::keep(datasets, ~ .x$animal_project_code %in% animal_project_code)[[1]] 
```

## Create file path

```{r}
dir <- here::here("data", "processed", animal_project_code)
```

## Create package and write Darwin Core

Get package:

```{r}
package <- etn::get_package(animal_project_code = dataset$animal_project_code)
```

Write files:

```{r}
etn::write_dwc(
  package = package,
  directory = file.path(dir, "dwc"),
  dataset_id = dataset$dataset_id,
  dataset_name = dataset$dataset_name,
  license = dataset$license,
  rights_holder = dataset$rights_holder
)
```

Write package: 

```{r}
etn::write_package(package, dir)
```
